name: nexus
description: NEXUS — browser-based AI development platform (agent-driven workspaces, sandboxed execution, Godot game builder).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @nexus/shared && npm run build -w @nexus/web && npm run build -w @nexus/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @nexus/shared && npm run typecheck -w @nexus/api && npm run typecheck -w @nexus/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
